full_prompt_en: A square interior photograph shows a dark gallery-like lounge layered with display shelves, large paintings and jewel-toned seating. A long deep teal sofa runs down the right side, its tufted back and pale cushions facing a low rectangular coffee table. A small round burgundy stool sits in the foreground on a richly patterned rug of red, blue and gold. Across the left side, a pale upholstered armchair turns inward; a mustard-yellow chair waits farther back beneath the tall shelving. The back wall is filled with black-framed display niches holding small objects, while a staircase cuts diagonally upward near the center. More glass-fronted shelves rise along the left wall, and large colorful artworks occupy the right wall above the sofa. Dark stone flooring, streaked with pale veining, borders the rug and reflects a few points of light. Above, a glossy dark ceiling panel mirrors fragments of the room; narrow recessed spotlights pick out the shelves and painted surfaces. Warm shaded lamps add amber pools around the seating, while a cooler diffuse glow reaches the distant back wall. Dense material contrasts remain readable: velvety upholstery, polished stone, glass shelves, metal frames and woven rug. The room contains no people or readable text. The overall composition is theatrical and collected, pulling the eye toward a deep central passage while the patterned rug and saturated seats warm the near foreground.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形室内照片呈现深色画廊式休息室，层叠的展示架、大幅绘画和宝石色座椅填满空间。一张深青蓝长沙发沿右侧延伸，绗缝靠背与浅色靠垫朝向低矮矩形茶几。前景中，一只酒红圆凳坐在红、蓝与金色繁密纹样地毯上。左侧，一把浅色软垫扶手椅朝内转动；更远处，高展示架下还有一把芥黄色椅。后墙布满黑框展示格，陈列小件物品，一道楼梯在中央附近斜向上切过。更多玻璃门架沿左墙升高，大幅多彩画作占据沙发上方的右墙。带浅色纹路的深石地面围住地毯，映出少量光点。上方，一块光亮深色天花板映出房间碎片；狭窄嵌灯照亮架子与画面表面。暖色灯罩在座席周围增加琥珀光池，较冷的漫射亮度则抵达远处后墙。密集材料对比仍清楚可辨：天鹅绒般软垫、抛光石材、玻璃架、金属框和编织地毯。房间无人，也没有可读文字。整体构图带舞台感与收藏气息，视线被引向深处中央通路，近前景则由花纹地毯和饱和色座椅升温。
style_prompt_en: A dramatic interior-photography treatment layers near-black framing, glossy reflective planes and saturated jewel accents. Deep teal, burgundy, ochre and occasional cream appear within a charcoal structure, keeping the palette rich but controlled. Pools of warm local light and narrow spotlights reveal selected textures while large recesses remain dark. Glass, polished stone, velvet-like softness and woven pattern each preserve a separate surface response; reflections add visual density without making the scene uniformly bright. Tall grids and diagonals pull the eye into depth, while a vivid patterned lower field anchors the foreground. Repeated framed rectangles organize many small details into an ordered rhythm. The overall effect is immersive, curated and theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 戏剧性的室内摄影处理叠加近黑色框架、光亮反射平面和饱和宝石色重音。深青蓝、酒红、赭黄与偶尔的奶油白置于炭黑结构内，让色盘浓郁而受控。局部暖光池与窄束聚光灯照出少数选定肌理，大型凹处仍留在暗中。玻璃、抛光石面、天鹅绒般的柔软和编织纹样各有独立的表面反应；反射增加视觉密度，却不把场景整体照亮。高格网与斜线把视线拉入纵深，鲜艳有纹样的下部色域固定前景。重复框状矩形把众多细节组织成有序节奏。整体效果沉浸、精心陈列，并带舞台感。
theme_en: A dark gallery-like lounge with jewel-toned seating, display shelves and a patterned rug
theme_zh: 深色画廊式休息室里摆着宝石色座椅、展示架和花纹地毯
name: Peter Marino
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
